name: Scien Brofiise
original_name: シアン・ブロフィワーズ
source:
[i]"A body is merely a vessel that houses a brain and a heart."[/i]

[i]Unwavering in his fate to preserve.[/i]

A talented scientist who is the director of the National Research Institute and creator of Reliver technology. He has lived for many years through his memory download system. He treats humans as expendable, and considers emotions to be bugs. His focus is on survival efficiency, for which he will not hesitate to use others or himself as test subjects in his research efforts.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Researcher, Director of the National Research Institute

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
